subject: Energy
title: How Fusion Works
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on How Fusion Works.

hook.text: Fusion powers the Sun—smashing hydrogen nuclei together to form helium, releasing vast energy in the process.

buildup.text: At 150 million °C, hydrogen nuclei move fast enough to overcome their electrical repulsion and fuse.

discovery.text: The mass of the product is slightly less than the inputs—the missing mass becomes energy via E=mc².

twist.text: Fusion fuel (deuterium) is abundant in seawater—one bathtub of water holds enough for a lifetime of energy.

climax.text: Fusion produces no long-lived radioactive waste and no CO₂—it's the ultimate clean energy source, if we can harness it.

punchline.text: The power of the Sun on Earth—that's the fusion dream.

quiz.question: What temperature is needed for fusion?
